verdict.rationale: Unity ships a built-in AI Assistant in the com.unity.ai.assistant package. Per its manual, you use it to create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance and perform project actions from natural-language prompts. Assistant messages are metered as Unity Credits, and the in-editor package resolves on Unity's registry. It is labeled beta/pre-release (2.20.0-pre.1), and the evidence consists of brief doc excerpts. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what tasks the Assistant can autonomously execute, independent or hands-on corroboration, non-beta/stable release status.
